name: dAVEBOx SA
description: An 8-track sequencer for Ableton Move, running Move under its own Schwung build. TEST BUILD, not in the catalog: install the release tarball through Schwung Manager (Modules → install from file), then Tools → dAVEBOx: the first launch installs everything else itself (needs a stock Schwung that carries schwung#419; older hosts get one root command). Stock Schwung is untouched and returns on exit or reboot.
